resources.string: No text-to-speech engine is installed. Install or enable one in Android settings, then try again.
The phone’s text-to-speech engine could not start. Check Android’s speech settings and try again.
This language has no compatible phone voice available.
The phone voice data for this language is missing. Install it in Android’s text-to-speech settings.
The installed speech engine does not support this language.
Your saved voice is no longer available. Choose the default voice or another installed voice.
Android did not grant audio focus. Check the phone’s media volume or try again.
Reading aloud stopped because the phone’s speech service reported an error. Tap Read aloud to try again.
Reading paused when another app needed audio. Tap Read aloud to restart from the beginning.
Reading stopped. Tap Read aloud to start again.
Reading aloud. Use Stop reading to stop; tap Read aloud again to restart.
The answer could not be shared from this device.
This changes speech speed only. Use the phone’s media controls to change loudness.
Read-aloud text is passed to the selected Android speech engine; its provider may process it remotely according to its own settings. MeBot does not send a new AI request for read aloud.
Live voice calls and transcription are separate from ChatGPT sign-in. They need an authorized MeBot voice service. No audio is sent unless you explicitly start an available voice action.

Your microphone audio will stream to OpenAI through the configured MeBot voice service. The session may include this conversation’s recent history and confirmed or topic-scoped context, not other chats. API voice usage is billed separately from ChatGPT. End the call whenever you like; locking or leaving the app stops microphone capture.
Selected story “%1$s”: its title, summary, available body sections and source details may be included. Caller-provided source references are not independently verified for this call.
Selected topic “%1$s” and its configured topic context may be included.
Recent messages from this conversation (%1$s) may be included.
Only confirmed About You or context scoped to the selected topic may be included.
No item, topic, history, or approved context is selected; only voice-session settings and microphone audio are sent.
Live voice is not configured for this app. A trusted MeBot service must be set up before a call can start.
The MeBot voice service is missing its authorization. No call was started.
Live voice is not enabled for the configured service.
Live voice requires separately authorized API access. ChatGPT sign-in does not grant this access.
The configured service does not currently have API voice access.
The live voice-call transport is not available yet. No call was started.
The configured voice service has reached its daily limit. No call was started.
Voice service status could not be checked. Try again later; no call was started.
The voice service already has an active call. End that call before starting another one.
No transcription service is configured. Voice recording is unavailable here; type your message instead. ChatGPT sign-in does not provide audio transcription.
Transcription is configured, but this app cannot reach the service yet. No recording was started.
The transcription service is missing its authorization. No recording was started.
The configured service has not enabled audio transcription.
The transcription service does not currently have API audio access.
The transcription service has reached its daily limit. No recording was started.
Transcription service status could not be checked. Try again later; no recording was started.
You can record only after choosing this action. MeBot will ask before sending audio for transcription; the text stays editable and is not sent as a chat message until you tap Send.
To prepare personalized starter questions, add confirmed About You or topic context. You can still start with any question.
Record up to 2 minutes. MeBot keeps this audio in its private app storage. Recording stops when you leave or lock the app; nothing is sent automatically.
Android will ask for microphone access when you tap Start. MeBot records only while this screen is active.
Microphone access was not granted. You can keep typing, or enable microphone access for MeBot in Android settings.
Speak clearly. Stop to keep this recording on your phone.
Preparing the recording on this device…
Audio is ready (%1$s). You can retry transcription, keep it locally, or discard it.
Recording stopped early (%1$s). The partial audio was kept; transcription may not work.
No transcription service is enabled for this workspace. This audio stays on your phone; it will not be sent, and no transcript has been created.
Transcription did not complete. The recording and your draft are still here. You can retry or discard the recording.
This removes the temporary audio from MeBot. Any text already in your draft stays unchanged.
Recording could not start. Check microphone permission and try again.
This recording could not be saved. Your text draft is unchanged.
If a transcription service is connected, Transcribe adds editable text to your question. Review it before tapping Send. The audio is never attached to the text question.
Transcript is in your draft. The audio remains local until you send the text or discard it.
Kept locally; it is not part of the text question.
Transcript is already in the composer. Edit it there before sending.
This sends the recording to %1$s for transcription. %2$s. No assistant request is made; review and edit the transcript before you tap Send.
The configured service may use its OpenAI API allowance; that usage is billed separately from ChatGPT.
This is a live, two-way audio session, not read-aloud or a saved voice note. Microphone access and an authorized MeBot voice service are required.
Microphone audio is streamed only while the call is active. API voice usage is billed separately from ChatGPT. End the call to stop microphone capture; leaving or locking the app also ends it.
Waiting for audio, events, and session readiness…
The response was interrupted. You can continue speaking.
ICE: gathering in progress. The call is not live yet.
ICE gathering completed; waiting for the remaining call checks.
No live call is active. You can retry explicitly or end and return.
